A system note recorded landlord approval with no amount and assigned a contractor. The case was then paused automatically because the property isn't tenanted. Amelia asked the contractor to quote and put the case on hold. The contractor replied, in what looks like an automated message, that the quote has been sent. No quote document or amount can be seen on the ticket.
